section_summary.extract_value: This section describes use of the Body Image States Scale (Cash et al., 2002) to measure daily body satisfaction, reporting Cronbach's alphas across study days (.83 to .90) and a mean weekly BISS score of 5.10 (SD = 1.11). The section does not provide sample size, participant demographics, BMI assessment, correlations with body appreciation, or an explicit study label.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Daily satisfaction with one's body was measured using the Body Image States Scale (Cash, Fleming, Alindogan, Steadman, & Whitehead, 2002)." "The Cronbach's alphas across the study days ranged from .83 to .90. Mean weekly score across participants was 5.10 (SD = 1.11)."
